evals.prompt: The day build published stale odds again. Everyone just needs to be more careful about checking freshness.
evals.expected_output: A mechanism replacing the promise to be careful.
expectations: Rejects 'be more careful' as the fix
Proposes a check that runs every time without anyone remembering
Names an owner and how the check is inspected
Names the failure it prevents and when to drop it if it never catches anything

evals.prompt: Third time this month someone symlinked a release folder. What do we do?
expectations: Proposes an automatic block or check, not a note or reminder
Says where it runs and who owns it
Says how anyone will know it is working
Keeps it to one mechanism, not a new process
